pr_title: Attempt to fix race with client disconnect
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/25179

I'm not a fan of locking on an internal field, but I needed the context to check if client disconnect has been called.

review_comments: If the `IISHttpContext` is only used for its lock object, shouldn't we just pass the lock object? That way _contextLock doesn't need to be made internal either.
